instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Civil engineering firm executing public infrastructure tenders including bridge rehabilitation, water treatment plants, and road widening projects. Operate our own heavy equipment fleet of 45 machines. Evaluating telematics-based predictive maintenance to reduce equipment downtime. We have a dedicated management team across core functions but operate with limited middle management layers. Budget cycles are annual with moderate flexibility for mid-year reallocation if a strong business case is presented. Innovation initiatives compete with day-to-day operational demands for team attention.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have never run a formal innovation initiative. Problems are solved ad-hoc as they arise, usually by the most directly affected team member. There is no dedicated budget, no structured ideation process, and no track record of experimenting with new technologies or business models beyond basic operational necessity.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base — our top 3 clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health. We need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including new product lines for different customer segments or entirely new business models that leverage our existing capabilities.
answers.teamSize: The innovation function is informal — one senior engineer has been given permission to spend 20% of their time exploring new technologies and prototyping ideas, but this allocation is frequently interrupted by production incidents and urgent feature requests. We have no dedicated innovation budget beyond standard cloud infrastructure costs.

input.changes_since_last: Major competitor entered our market. Customer churn rising. Need to accelerate digital transformation.

opportunities.title: Implement Formalized Innovation Funnel & Process
opportunities.rationale: The current ad-hoc solutioning process creates significant internal drag and prevents scaling innovation efforts. Establishing a formal funnel (Ideation -> Pilot -> Scale) will structure the 20% time allocation, ensuring that exploratory work is measurable and repeatable.

first_actions: Establish cross-functional 'Innovation Champions' from key departments (Engineering, Ops).
Define clear intake criteria and scoring mechanisms for new ideas, prioritizing regulatory compliance review early on.
Conduct a mandatory 2-day workshop to map current pain points into structured problem statements.
resources_needed: Minimal budget for process mapping tools/external facilitator
Internal subject matter experts from Operations and Engineering.
execution_plan.success_metric: Completion of the first 3 structured ideas moving through Stage 1 (Vetting).
milestones: Formal review board established and meeting bi-weekly (End of Quarter 1)

opportunities.title: Develop Managed Equipment Performance Services (MEPS)
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging the existing heavy equipment fleet and interest in telematics allows Fusion Systems to diversify revenue away from pure construction labor. This service model mitigates concentration risk by offering predictive maintenance contracts directly to clients.

first_actions: Pilot MEPS with a single, non-critical client (Proof of Concept).
Integrate telematics data into existing preventative maintenance scheduling processes, ensuring regulatory reporting compliance.
Develop tiered service packages based on equipment uptime guarantees.
resources_needed: Training for field technicians on predictive diagnostics
Legal consultation for new Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
execution_plan.success_metric: Securing a paid contract based solely on MEPS revenue within 9 months.
milestones: Integration of first fleet set and baseline data collection (Month 3)
Presentation of initial ROI/KPI report to the Executive Committee (Month 6)

next_steps.action: Mandate an executive decision on ring-fencing time/budget (minimum 10% of senior engineer's time) specifically for MEPS development, protecting it from urgent operational demands.
Formalize a systematic customer feedback loop by developing structured interviews or usage surveys for the top 5 clients, identifying pain points not related to scope creep.

Identify and document 2-3 non-core service areas where existing equipment capabilities could be utilized for minor diversification revenue streams (e.g., specialized material handling, site surveying).

key_weaknesses: Lack of formalized innovation process resulting in ad-hoc problem solving.
Extreme dependency on the top 3 clients (55% revenue concentration risk).
Difficulty in allocating and protecting dedicated time/budget for long-term strategic initiatives against day-to-day operational pressures.

improvements: Increased awareness of diversification risk, shifting focus beyond merely executing projects.
Dedicated resources (senior engineer's 20% time) have been identified for exploratory work.
Active interest and preliminary exploration into digital solutions (telematics).
persistent_gaps: The lack of a formal governance structure means that strategic initiatives remain vulnerable to operational interruptions ('time' barrier).
No formal mechanism exists to harvest, analyze, or act upon customer feedback beyond the immediate project scope.
achieved_milestones: Initial recognition and articulation of diversification necessity.
Preliminary scoping of telematics feasibility for predictive maintenance.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The market has become more competitive (competitor entry) and client retention is challenging (rising churn). The company has shifted focus from basic operational improvement to strategic survival through diversification and digital transformation.
